//: What only Python has, added to the docstrings that scripts/python-api.mjs writes from the TSDoc comments: the shapes and dtypes of the NumPy arrays. Keys are the Python names; a function gets {type, doc} as its Returns section, a constant a string as its last paragraph.

symcrys.LATTICE_SYMMETRY_DIRECTIONS: In Python: family → one int64 array of shape (n, 3) per position, the n directions [uvw] as rows.

operations.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 3, 3), ``cartesian`` a float64 array of shape (n, 3, 3); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

generators.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 3, 3), ``cartesian`` a float64 array of shape (n, 3, 3); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

lattice_basis.doc: A float64 array of shape (3, 3), a new array on each call; a, b, c are its columns.

describe_operations.doc: In each, ``axis`` (if present) has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

symmetry_directions.doc: Each entry of ``directions`` has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

site_symmetry.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``direction`` float64 array of shape (3,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

wyckoff_positions.doc: In each, ``site_symmetry_operations`` is an int64 array of shape (n,).

tensor_form.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3, …, 3), each allowed tensor with its rank axes; ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank); ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3, …, 3), constraints r with (r * t).sum() == 0 for every allowed tensor t; ``rank``. p is the number of free parameters.

tensor_form_of.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3, …, 3), each allowed tensor with its rank axes; ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank); ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3, …, 3), constraints r with (r * t).sum() == 0 for every allowed tensor t; ``rank``. p is the number of free parameters.

rotate_tensors.doc: A float64 array of the shape of ``tensors``: a stack of n tensors, each of the shape (3, …, 3) or the flat (3**rank,), where the structured shape is read first (at rank 1 an (n, 3) array is n vectors). ``rotation`` is one rotation (3, 3) for all tensors or one per tensor (n, 3, 3). For stacks that broadcast against each other, ``rotate_tensor`` takes any leading axes.

rotate_tensor.doc: A float64 array of the shape of ``tensor``: a tensor has the shape (3, …, 3) or the flat (3**rank,), where the structured shape is read first (at rank 1 a (3, 3) array is three vectors). Leading axes of ``tensor`` and of ``rotation`` (…, 3, 3) are stacks, broadcast as in NumPy: a rotation of shape (k, 3, 3) gives the tensor rotated by each of the k rotations, a stack of tensors (m, 3, …, 3) each tensor rotated.

orbit.doc: In each, ``hkl`` (or ``uvw``) is an int64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,). Give ``hkl=`` for a face or ``uvw=`` for a lattice direction.

orbit_of.doc: In each, ``direction`` is a float64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,).

wyckoff_position.doc: ``site_symmetry_operations`` is an int64 array of shape (n,).

site_symmetry_of.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``direction`` float64 array of shape (3,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

residual_operations.doc: The kept operations of the caller, in their order.

to_voigt.doc: A float64 array: shape (6,) at rank 2, (3, 6) for a tensor symmetric in its last pair, (6, 3) in its first, (6, 6) at rank 4. ``tensor`` may have the shape (3, …, 3) or the flat (3**rank,).

from_voigt.doc: A float64 array of shape (3, …, 3), the tensor with its rank axes.

plane_group.doc: ``centring_translations`` is a float64 array of shape (n, 2), n = 0 or 1.

operations.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 2, 2), ``translation`` a float64 array of shape (n, 2); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

generators.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 2, 2), ``translation`` a float64 array of shape (n, 2); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

describe_operations.doc: ``translation``, ``point`` and ``glide`` (where present) are float64 arrays of shape (2,), ``direction`` an int64 array of shape (2,), ``axis`` a dict ``{"lattice"}`` with an int64 array of shape (2,).

describe_operations_of.doc: As ``describe_operations``: ``translation``, ``point`` and ``glide`` (where present) float64 arrays of shape (2,), ``direction`` an int64 array of shape (2,), ``axis`` a dict ``{"lattice"}`` with an int64 array of shape (2,).

site_symmetry.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``; for a point (``point=``) also ``point``, a float64 array of shape (2,).

wyckoff_distances.doc: One per Wyckoff position, in the order of ``wyckoff_positions``: ``letter``, ``multiplicity``, ``site_symmetry``, ``coordinates`` as there, ``point`` a float64 array of shape (2,) and ``distance`` a float.

orbit.doc: In each, ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,), and the image: ``point`` a float64 array of shape (2,), or ``uv`` or ``hk`` an int64 array of shape (2,).

asymmetric_unit.doc: ``inequalities`` an int64 array of shape (m, 3), ``vertices`` a float64 array of shape (n, 2), ``edges`` an int64 array of shape (n,), indices into ``inequalities``.

symmetry_elements.doc: ``rotation_points``: dicts ``{"n", "point"}``, point a float64 array of shape (2,); ``lines``: dicts ``{"kind", "direction", "axis", "glide", "point"}``, direction an int64 array of shape (2,), axis a dict ``{"lattice"}`` with an int64 array of shape (2,), glide and point float64 of shape (2,).
